coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO due to an API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: The audit tool should implement retries for transient API errors to prevent a single metadata file failure from cascading into an inconclusive package verdict.
Models are correctly ignoring 'SKIP' checksums on tarballs as a hygiene issue rather than an injection, which aligns with the threat model.
